# Catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_catalog.py from catalog/catalog.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Reviewed 2026-10-11. Ratings are the maintainer's judgment on a 1-10 scale, not measurements. Weights: usefulness for day-to-day engineering and business-document work 40%, runtime and context cost 20% (cheaper is better), risk 20% (safer is better), maturity and upkeep 10%, uniqueness versus overlapping tools 10%. Vendor benchmark claims are reported as claims unless a measurement is named.

| Rating | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 9-10 | Install and keep on |
| 7-8 | Install, use by profile |
| 5-6 | Situational; install cold |
| 3-4 | Niche or risky; keep inert |
| 1-2 | Skip |

## Rating notes

- **Matt Pocock skills** (8): High quality and small. Overlaps with other planning and TDD skills, so use one per task.
- **RTK** (8): Largest measured saving of the set. Condensed diffs can hide detail, so keep an escape hatch.
- **codebase-memory-mcp** (8): Native Windows ARM64 build, no telemetry found, strong fit for big repos.
- **Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)** (7): Broad and well structured, but largely overlaps with other process skills. Loading all of it hot would crowd the skill listing.
- **Diagram design** (7): One skill, low context cost, clear output.
- **Ponytail** (7): Fits a minimal-code policy. Value is smaller if your own rules already say the same.
- **Founder skill** (6): Useful framing; do not present its numbers as facts.
- **Graphify** (6): Good for mixed material. Overlaps with a code-only graph server.
- **Moli** (6): Capable, but it embeds a JavaScript engine that runs page code, and platform browser tools already cover most uses.
- **Context Mode** (5): Strong idea, invasive implementation. Revisit when its hook behavior is opt-in.
- **API Anything** (4): Powerful and risky; terms-of-service exposure on logged-in sites.
- **REA** (4): Rarely needed and high blast radius.
- **Reverse API Engineer** (4): Niche, and the default permission posture is too loose for a workstation.
- **OmniRoute** (n/a): Not rated: not installed.
- **TensorFlow** (n/a): Not rated: not installed.
- **Transformers** (n/a): Not rated: not installed.
